name: Route 110
lines:
The door is locked.
A message is written on the scroll on the door:
“Write the secret code here.”
A secret code is written on it.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 3 AM I!
DO YOU FEEL CONFIDENT?
AN ESCAPE ROPE, $550!
YOU’D BETTER BUY ONE!

CLICKETY-CLACK...
NICE DOING BUSINESS WITH YOU!

YOU HAVE PLENTY.
NO NEED TO BUY.
